37
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, March 6, 2018/Phalguna 15, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Finance; Health and Family
Welfare; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power)
Total number of questions — 15
Loans written off by PSBs
†*106. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
Public Sector Banks (PSBs) have written
off ` 81,683 crore in the year 2016-17,
whereas in the year 2012-13, this amount
was just ` 27,231 crore;
(b) whether it is a fact that State Bank
of India had written off loans of  ` 20,339
crore in the year 2016-17;
(c) the total amount of loans written
off by various nationalised banks in the
year 2017-18; and
(d) the amount of loans given to farmers
out of those written off amount?
Financial restructuring of Air India
*107. SHRI RIPUN BORA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIA TION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
reform Air India by means of any specific
Alternative Mechanism before divesting;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that the previous
Government had approved ` 30,000 crore
turnaround and financial restructuring
package spanning upto 2021 for Air India;
and
(d) if so, the details of improvement in
its financial operations management?
Exorbitant medical fees charged by
private hospitals
*108. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
private sector hospitals which cover 80 per
cent  of  India's healthcare often indulge in
systematic loot and extract huge money
from the patients often running into lakhs;
(b) if so, how many such cases have
been noticed during last six months;

38
(c) whether it is also a fact that private
hospitals have to keep showing increasing
profits every year to be considered a success
and charge exorbitant charges from the
patients; and
(d) if so, what is Government's reaction
in this regard and by when this problem is
likely to be addressed by Government?
Evasion of GST by e-Commerce
companies
*109. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of  FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
certain e-Commerce companies in the
country have violated the licensing policy
and evaded Goods and Services Tax (GST);
(b) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken by Government in this regard; and
(c) whether any mechanism has been
developed and monitoring  done to see that
online trading by e-Commerce companies
entirely come under the tax net and the
revenue is recovered?
Loss of market capital by PNB
*110. SHRI RITABRATA  BANERJEE:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Punjab
National Bank (PNB) has lost one-third of
its market capital in a fraud recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how the huge amount of public
money will be recovered and the details
thereof?
Foreign institutional investors
*111. DR. VIKAS MAHATME: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of foreign
institutional investors operating in Indian
stock markets;
(b) the names of different foreign
institutional investors and their exposure
in different stock exchanges; and
(c) the details thereof, State-wise?
FDI in different sectors
†*112. SHRI NARESH AGRAW AL:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that foreign
investors have not shown any interest in
some of the sectors even though such
sectors have a provision of 100 per cent
FDI;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the names of such sectors
where foreign investment is done and
quantum of such investment made during
last three years?
Water scarcity at thermal power
plants
*113. SHRI N. GOKULA-
KRISHNAN: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India lost
about 14 terawatt hours of thermal power
generation due to water shortage in 2016;
(b) whether it is also a fact that this has
led to the cancelling out of more than 20
per cent of growth in the country's total
electricity generation from 2015;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

39
(c) whether it is also a fact that about
40 per cent of the country's thermal power
plants are facing great stress in terms of
water availability; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Projects sanctioned to Karnataka
Biodiversity Board
*114. SHRI K. C. RAMAMURTHY:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some projects
have been sanctioned to Karnataka
Biodiversity Board in 2015-16 relating to
medicinal plants protection and
documentation;
(b) if so, the details of

Total number of questions — 160
Ayurveda doctors and yoga teachers
for rural areas
1121. SHRIMATI SAROJINI
HEMBRAM: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPA THY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has
formulated any policy to appoint more
number of Ayurveda doctors and Yoga
teachers/instructors in the rural areas and
villages in our country for mass awareness
and treatment for poor people;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Agreement between India and
Malaysia on traditional
systems of medicine
1122. SHRI AMAR SHANKAR
SABLE: Will the Minister ofAYURVEDA,
YOGA & NATUROPA THY, UNANI,
SIDDHA AND HOMOEOPA THY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is an
agreement signed between India and
Malaysia for Traditional Systems of
Medicine;
(b) if so. the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that there is
an issue of registration of A YUSH
practitioners and products in Malaysia; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken by Government to resolve this issue?
 Establishing Herbs Collection
Centres in Tamil Nadu
1123. DR. R. LAKSHMANAN: Will
the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NA TUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government will come
forward to establish Herbs Collection
Centres in the State of Tamil Nadu

264
considering the presence of  Western Ghats
and Eastern Ghats in the State;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Promoting homoeopathy
1124. SHRI V . VIJAY ASAI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has noted that
over 1500 independent studies have
concluded that homoeopathy is a
pseudoscience;
(b) the reasons why Government still
has a department for promoting
homoeopathy;
(c) whether there is any evidence, not
anecdotal in nature, which Government has
that proves that homoeopathy is more
beneficial than placebo; and
(d) any evidence, not anecdotal in
nature, which Government has that
warrants the promotion or acceptance of
homoeopathy in India?
 Tribal Health Care Research
Programme
1125. SHRI PARIMAL NATHWANI:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY , UNAN1, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
start Tribal Health Care Research
Programme (THCRP) by the Central
Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences
(CCRAS);
(b) if so, the aims and objectives thereof;
(c) the details of targets set for 2017-18
and achievement made so far under
THCRP; and
(d) the number of tribals likely to be
covered under the said project?
 Extension of runways of airports
1126. SHRI K. R. ARJUNAN: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the plans of
Airports Authority of India (AAI) to
extend runways-of a number of airports
were grounded;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that AAI had
invested huge amount for the extension of
runways at those airports; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
 Unlawful activities by crew of Jet
Airways
1127. SARDAR BALWINDER
SINGH BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
CIVIL A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Directorate General Civil
Aviation (DGCA) is aware of unlawful
activities of crew members of Jet Airways
such as smuggling activities, mid-air brawls
and misbehaviour, with passengers, etc;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) action taken by DGCA on various
unlawful activities of crew members
including details of matter taken up by
DGCA with the management of Jet
Airways?

265
 Air services to Satna and Rewa under
UDAN Scheme
†1128. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has launched
UDAN Scheme, to be completed in several
phases, to provide the facility of air travel
to the common man of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has announced
air services from Bhopal to Satna and  Rewa
in the first phase of the `Udan' Scheme;
and
(d) if so, the by when the air service
from Bhopal to Satna and Rewa would be
started?
 Exploitation of air travellers through
dynamic pricing system

SAHASRABUDDHE: Will the Minister
of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any
mechanism to ensure that air travellers are
not exploited through Dynamic pricing
system of charging different air fares to
different people at different places at
different points in time, if so, the details
thereof;
